first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.npc: Look, here come 'nother wan'be jubbly chaser.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.speaker: Ros
first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: Be nice, Gurt, or you'll scare off another one!

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.player: Another what? What are you two doing here?

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.npc: Me's big boss of of dis boatsie skill test. Call it Jubbly Jive. Only best wiv boatsies can hunt da jubblies.
Gurtob is da bestest jubbly hunter in all of da seas. No one surpass Gurtob.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.player: Boatsies? Jubblies? Skill test? What's going on here.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.speaker: Ros
first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: I'll take it from here, Gurt.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.speaker: Ros
first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: Dis... Sorry, this corner of the Shrouded Ocean is where we Barracudas like to challenge ourselves to a fun Barracuda Trial called the Jubbly Jive.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.speaker: Ros
first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: While he may not look it, Gurtob here is actually an expert sailor and trial master for the Barracudas.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.player: An ogre is a trial master for the Barracudas? That's surprising.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.speaker: Ros
first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: Not at all! He may be rough around the edges and difficult to understand at times, but he's a fantastic sailor and that's the only thing us Barracudas care about.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.player: I see. So what do I do here? What's the challenge?

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.npc: Creatures talk... talk... long. Go da fastest, grab da toadies, throw da toadies, trick da jubblies, eat da jubblies. Dat's it.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: If the player does not have 55 Sailing:

steps.npc: Weak creature needs more boatsie skills first.

steps.speaker: Ros
steps.text: Yes, you'd probably benefit from testing your sailing skills elsewhere before attempting this trial.

steps.player: Thanks for the advice. I'll bear that in mind.

steps.text: You require a Sailing level of 55 to take on the Jubbly Jive.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.speaker: Ros
first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: The goal of this trial is to use balloon toads to lure jubblies. First up, you'll want to sail west to collect da... sorry, collect the balloon toads from a boat of ours.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.speaker: Ros
first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: On your way, keep an eye out for any lost supplies. You'll need to collect all of them to complete the trial.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.speaker: Ros
first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: Sailing over rapids will give you a burst of speed! Try to go over as many as you can. The more rapids you go through in quick succession, the faster you'll go!

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.speaker: Ros
first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: As you continue sailing west, keep an eye out for the jubblies. Remembering where they are will help you later in the trial. They tend to be perched on top of rocky outcrops or trees growing out of the water.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.speaker: Ros
first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: The total number of them will depend on the rank you're going for. They're also fairly consistent, so your experience should be the same during each trial attempt.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.speaker: Ros
first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: Once you've sailed far enough west, you should be able to spot the boat where you can collect the balloon toads from. The maximum amount you can collect depends on the rank you're going for.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.speaker: Ros
first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: Once you've collected some balloon toads, you'll want to start sailing back this way so you can begin luring the jubblies.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.speaker: Ros
first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: As you sail, watch out for the extra thick stagnant patches of water. They'll slow down any boat, so do your best to avoid them.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.speaker: Ros
first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: As you keep making your way back, you'll want to start luring the jubblies back with you. The goal is to lure all of them back to us here.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.speaker: Ros
first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: To lure a jubbly, look out for empty outcrops similar to the ones they like to perch on. If you throw a balloon toad at one of these outcrops, a nearby jubbly will move to it.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.speaker: Ros
first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: It's worth noting that jubblies will only travel to the closest outcrop to them, so you'll need to lure them one outcrop at a time. Make sure to keep track of where you've thrown toads and where the jubblies started.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.speaker: Ros
first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: When attempting higher ranks, you may want to set up balloon toads at multiple outcrops ahead of time!

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.speaker: Ros
first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: While the jubblies are important, don't forget to keep collecting the lost supplies as you come back as well.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.speaker: Ros
first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: If you can lure all the jubblies and collect all the lost supplies in the time given, you'll be awarded a Barracuda rank! Each trial has three ranks: Swordfish, Shark or Marlin. Each rank is harder than the last.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.speaker: Ros
first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: For this trial, you'll be asked to lure additional jubblies and collect even more lost supplies as the rank increases.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.speaker: Ros
first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: You can't attempt the next rank until you beat the one before it. You can also try unranked if you'd like to warm up beforehand.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.npc: See, is like Gurtob said so. Go da fastest, grab da toadies, throw da toadies, trick da jubblies, eat da jubblies. Dat's it.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.player: I see. Do you have any tips or tricks for me?

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.speaker: Ros
first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: Of course!

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.speaker: Ros
first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: First up, you're going to need a boat with at least a mithril helm in order to withstand the strong rapids here, but don't forget, provided you can withstand them, they'll give you a burst of speed!

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.speaker: Ros
first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: Secondly, you really want to try to avoid the fetid pools around us. They won't harm you or your boat, but they will completely kill all momentum you've built up.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.speaker: Ros
first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: The only way to get across them is by using a wind catcher, but even then the timing is tricky, so we only give those out to sailors who have achieved at least Shark rank here.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.speaker: Ros
first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: Thirdly, trim your sails frequently to build up even more speed, but be careful! While it's important to go fast, doing so can make it harder to navigate around the fetid pools.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.speaker: Ros
first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: If I were you, I'd consider briefly lowering your speed for those tricky turns to avoid getting your boat stuck.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.npc: Hah! Gurtob sail never go down. Only go fastest.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.speaker: Ros
first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.text: Finally, and you probably don't need to be told, but watch out for those rocks, hitting them will put a stop to all of your momentum, just like the pools.

first-talk-after-completing-pandemonium.player: Thanks for the advice. I'll bear that in mind.

steps.text: He's right, you know. Whilst exploring the ocean, a group of Barracudas saw Gurtob 'sailing' around this place on what could barely be described as a boat, hunting jubblies.

steps.npc: Dey join in and try steal Gurtob jub jubs! But creatures nice and give Gurtob strong boatsie. Now Gurtob friends.

steps.speaker: Ros
steps.text: Gurtob friends indeed! When the Barracudas tried it themselves, they realised how much fun it was sailing around these tight spaces. They worked with Gurtob to design this trial!

steps.npc: Gurtob make bestest trial back then! Now yous little creatures make it easier, but me think it still best.

steps.speaker: Ros
steps.text: It's true that some claim the trial is easier now than before due to new pathways being carved through the fetid pools. Still, don't let that fool you! The course is still a tricky one!

steps.player: So what do I need to do during the trial?

steps.npc: Go da fastest, grab da toadies, throw da toadies, trick da jubblies, eat da jubblies. Dat's it.

steps.speaker: Ros
steps.text: Let me explain it in non-Gurtob terms...

steps.npc: Me's Gurtob. Da fastest jubbly hunter on boatsies and big boss of dis boatsie skill test.

steps.speaker: Ros
steps.text: And I'm Ros. I'm fairly new to the Barracudas and I help Gurtob out with managing this trial.

steps.speaker: Ros
steps.text: He's not much of a speaker and is easily misunderstood, so I help translate and make sure that any up and coming prospective Barracudas understand exactly what they need to do.

steps.player: Why stay out here in this awful smelling place? Aren't there better places to be at sea?

steps.npc: Dis Gurtob home. Only funny smelly is you's scrawny creatures.
Gurtob find funny when you's creatures gets stucks in bubbly watery. Gurtob also likes when you's creatures bring da jubblies.

steps.player: I get what's in it for him, but what's in it for you, Ros?

steps.speaker: Ros
steps.text: Well, after joining the Barracudas, I discovered a fascination for different cultures. This is just a small step in my personal journey to understand more about the world!

steps.speaker: Ros
steps.text: Plus da jubblies do taste good!

steps.npc: Da jubblies do taste da bestest.
Dey like da creatures which sound like da fishies but no taste like da fishes but fast like da fastest fishies.

steps.speaker: Ros
steps.text: Gurtob sure has a way with words!

steps.speaker: Ros
steps.text: Us Barracudas are the fastest sailors across the entire ocean! Our motto is 'Anyone from anywhere as long as they can sail.'

steps.speaker: Ros
steps.text: We work together to help hone each other's skills and test our mettle through challenges called Barracuda Trials.

steps.speaker: Ros
steps.text: Of course you can! There's a bunch of trial masters like Gurtob scattered across the seas. Best our trials and earn your spot in our ranks.
